final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS ol, o.dealedge AS side, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS av, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), s2 AS (SELECT side AS side2, AVG(av) AS av2 FROM s1 GROUP BY side) SELECT s1.ol, s1.side, s1.av, s1.cnt, s1.av - s2.av2 AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.side = s2.side2 WHERE s1.av > s2.av2 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
